status_summary: No feasibility study of merging the statistical agencies was found, but the Administration has twice proposed reorganizing them in its budget. The FY2026 request proposed moving the Bureau of Labor Statistics from Labor to Commerce, and Congress declined: per CRS, the FY2026 appropriations law (Public Law 119-74, signed 2026-01-23) does not fund BLS under Commerce. The FY2027 budget appendix, released 2026-04-03, states in the Census Bureau, BEA and BLS accounts that the Budget proposes to reorganize BLS, BEA and the Census Bureau at the Department of Commerce, without describing the structure. Per CRS, the FY2027 request seeks 600 million dollars for BLS under Commerce, and the House Appropriations Committee bill for FY2027 (H.R. 8845, reported 2026-05-15) does not fund BLS under Commerce. No bill carrying out a merger was found.

timeline.event: Public Law 119-74 (FY2026 Commerce, Justice, Science appropriations) is signed; per CRS, it does not provide funding for BLS under the Commerce Department, so the requested move of BLS to Commerce was not adopted.

The FY2027 President's Budget is released; its Department of Commerce appendix chapter states, under the Census Bureau, BEA and BLS accounts, that the Budget proposes to reorganize BLS, BEA and the Census Bureau at the Department of Commerce (release date per The Census Project).

The House Appropriations Committee reports H.R. 8845, the FY2027 Commerce, Justice, Science bill (H.Rept. 119-625); per CRS it provides no funding for BLS under the Commerce Department, so the requested move was not adopted at committee stage.

title: Study merging the Census Bureau, BEA and BLS into one statistical bureau
uncertainties: The FY2027 appendix states the reorganization only in one sentence repeated under three accounts; page numbers were read from extracted text and may be approximate, and the FY2027 congressional justifications were not opened. The FY2026 request's release date and wording were not read directly; the proposal and its rejection rest on the CRS overview. An advocacy-group summary reports that the Commerce Secretary described a plan to place the Census Bureau, BLS and BEA in one agency at a House appropriations hearing on 2025-06-05; the hearing record was not read, so it is not a timeline event. The FY2027 House committee action was read through CRS R48929 (update of 2026-06-23); the committee bill and report were not opened. A Senate FY2027 markup scheduled for 2026-06-25 was reported postponed by an advocacy source, and later Senate or floor action was not checked. CRS describes the FY2027 request as moving BLS to Commerce, while the appendix speaks of reorganizing all three bureaus there; neither describes a single merged bureau. Blocked was considered because Congress declined the FY2026 move, but the FY2027 request keeps the proposal live.
